name: spares-stocking
description: Find spare parts that are short, below reorder point or set with the wrong min/max, from stock, reservations, purchase orders, usage and lead times you paste. Matches part numbers across the records, catches unit, revision and duplicate-item mismatches, counts only usable stock and firm receipts, handles slow-moving and intermittent demand with a stated assumption, and checks a critical spare parts list against stock and equipment parts lists. For storeroom and MRO planners and reliability engineers.
